title: Complex cubic frontier benchmark contract
objective: Implement a deterministic two-pass 1000-field complex-cubic class-group census and calibrated frontier timing runner with machine schemas and fake-process regression tests

oracles: PARI/GP bnfinit flag 0 under GRH semantics
LMFDB exact complex cubic field records with used_grh=false

handoff.summary: Added an offline deterministic 1,000-field LMFDB corpus generator, a strict two-pass Sage.js/PARI frontier runner, optional Magma/Hecke JSON adapters, canonical machine schemas, protocol documentation, and fake-process/clock regression coverage. The runner fixes direct GP conditional semantics at bnfinit(...,0), keeps scalar-prepared and fresh-complete roots contiguous, performs authenticated Sage.js receipt replay outside timing, and reports raw/paired/stratified frontier evidence.
risks: The lane has no installed GP executable, so direct-GP source generation is contract-tested but awaits an integration smoke run with PARI.
Magma and Hecke are supported through a strict adapter protocol but no site-specific adapter executable is bundled.
